title: ECMAScript: Test if Array.some() is supported
product-requirement: Device needs to support Array.prototype.some() to test whether at least one element in the array passes the test implemented by the provided function.
specification: Terminals MUST implement at least ECMAScript 6.0 [1]
assertion: The array.some() method tests whether at least one element in the array passes the test implemented by the provided function. It returns a Boolean value.
